rule_outs: Dwelling 1 m from the best section
summary: Very steep Adsett Street kerb with houses 1-9 m from it.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 1-12 m away along the whole kerb; apartments at the north end.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street; cars are parked on the opposite side, little room here.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street ending at a cross street.
drivers.convention: Cars park nearby, but weekday 7am-6pm no-parking signs apply.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m for most of the stretch
sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the west.
